process VARDICTRUST {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
?         'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/33/33ba32a84ffa98e9001a1079218cc9deb09a41939afe85fa189a090665aad393/data'
:         'community.wave.seqera.io/library/htslib_vardictrust:8e6fd2fa9924d063' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(bams), path(bais), path(bed)
    tuple val(meta2), path(fasta)
    tuple val(meta3), path(fasta_fai)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.vcf.gz"), emit: vcf
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('vardictrust'), eval('vardictrust --version | head -n 1 | sed \'s/.* //\''), emit: versions_vardictrust, topic: versions
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('htslib'), eval("tabix -h 2>&1 | sed -n '2s/Version: *//p'"), emit: versions_htslib, topic: versions

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: '-c 1 -S 2 -E 3 -z'
    def args2 = task.ext.args2 ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"

    // A lone BAM may arrive as a 1-element List; unwrap it so it never mis-dispatches as somatic
    def bam_input = bams instanceof List && bams.size() == 1 ? bams[0] : bams
    def somatic = bam_input instanceof List && bam_input.size() == 2
    // Single-quoted Groovy: the emitted shell keeps -b "tumor|normal" double-quoted so | is never a pipe
    def input = somatic ? '-b "' + bam_input[0] + '|' + bam_input[1] + '"' : "-b ${bam_input}"
    """
    set -o pipefail

    vardictrust \\
        ${args} \\
        ${input} \\
        -N "${meta.id}" \\
        --threads ${task.cpus} \\
        -G ${fasta} \\
        ${bed} \\
        | bgzip ${args2} --threads ${task.cpus} > ${prefix}.vcf.gz
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"

    """
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.vcf.gz
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/vardictrust"
description: "Memory-safe Rust rewrite of VarDictJava for single and paired sample\
  \ variant calling"
keywords:
- "variant calling"
- "vcf"
- "bam"
- "snv"
- "indel"
tools:
- vardictrust:
    description: "Fast, memory-safe Rust rewrite of VarDictJava v1.8.3 for single\
      \ and paired sample variant calling (upstream VarDictJava: https://github.com/AstraZeneca-NGS/VarDictJava)"
    homepage: "https://github.com/palakpsheth/VarDictRust"
    documentation: "https://vardictrust.readthedocs.io/"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/palakpsheth/VarDictRust"
    doi: "10.1093/nar/gkw227"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    - "GPL-2.0-or-later"
    args_id: "$args"
    identifier: "biotools:vardictrust"
- htslib:
    description: "Set of tools for manipulating high-throughput sequencing data; bgzip\
      \ compresses the VCF output"
    homepage: "http://www.htslib.org/"
    documentation: "http://www.htslib.org/doc/bgzip.html"
    doi: "10.1093/gigascience/giab007"
    publication:
      author: "Bonfield, J. K., Marshall, J., Danecek, P., Li, H., Ohan, V., Whitwham,\
        \ A., Keane, T. & Davies, R. M."
      year: 2021
      title: "HTSlib: C library for reading/writing high-throughput sequencing data"
      source: "GigaScience"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    args_id: "$args2"
    identifier: "biotools:samtools"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test', single_end:false\
        \ ]\n"
  - bams:
      type: "file"
      description: "One or two BAM or CRAM files. Supply two BAM/CRAM files to run\
        \ in paired (tumour/normal) mode."
      pattern: "*.{bam,cram}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/data_0863"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3462"
  - bais:
      type: "file"
      description: "Index/indices of the BAM or CRAM file(s) (.bai, .csi, or .crai)"
      pattern: "*.{bai,csi,crai}"
      ontologies: []
  - bed:
      type: "file"
      description: "BED with the regions of interest"
      pattern: "*.bed"
      ontologies: []
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing fasta information\ne.g. [ id:'test', single_end:false\
        \ ]\n"
  - fasta:
      type: "file"
      description: "FASTA of the reference genome"
      pattern: "*.{fa,fasta}"
      ontologies: []
- - meta3:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing fasta information\ne.g. [ id:'test', single_end:false\
        \ ]\n"
  - fasta_fai:
      type: "file"
      description: "The index of the FASTA of the reference genome"
      pattern: "*.fai"
      ontologies: []
output:
  vcf:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test',\
          \ single_end:false ]\n"
    - '*.vcf.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "VCF file output"
        pattern: "*.vcf.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/data_3498"
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
  versions_vardictrust:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - vardictrust:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - vardictrust --version | head -n 1 | sed 's/.* //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
  versions_htslib:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - htslib:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - 'tabix -h 2>&1 | sed -n ''2s/Version: *//p''':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - vardictrust:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - vardictrust --version | head -n 1 | sed 's/.* //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - htslib:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - 'tabix -h 2>&1 | sed -n ''2s/Version: *//p''':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
